description: NFL DFS projections for Week 8 on DraftKings: Jahmyr Gibbs leads the SPAGS model at 27.9. Full QB, RB, WR, TE and DST projections, values and sim plays.
body:
NFL DFS Projections Week 8: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 29, 9:10 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate: 27.9 DraftKings points at $9,500. He also holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Chase Brown second at 25% for $6,300.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Bijan Robinson (24.1, $8,500), Josh Allen (22.7, $7,700), Kenneth Walker III (22.7, $8,800) and Dak Prescott (21.8, $6,300). Dak Prescott returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.46 projected points per $1,000. Puka Nacua leads the wide receivers at 21.1 for $8,600, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 22.7 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 18.3 for $7,400.

The 11-game slate runs from a 54.5-point total in ARI at DAL down to 39.5 in CLE at PIT. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 29, 9:10 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 8 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs BAL ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.7 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.9 points clear of Dak Prescott. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.95 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.6 points with a simulated floor of 9.2 and a ceiling of 42.0, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Baltimore, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 53.5.

Dak Prescott, DAL vs ARI ($6,300)

Dak Prescott projects 2nd at the position with 21.8 DraftKings points at $6,300, 5th on the main slate overall. The salary works out to 3.46 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott averaged 21.9 points with a simulated floor of 8.7 and a ceiling of 40.1, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 6-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30.25 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Malik Willis, MIA vs NE ($4,900)

Malik Willis projects for 16.9 DraftKings points at $4,900, which works out to 3.45 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 5.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Willis averaged 17.1 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 31.2, and he holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Miami is a 7.5-point underdog at home against New England, with an implied team total of 18.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.
